text.p: The Translation Group Ltd said Monday it completed the acquisition of Word House Associates for 385,000 common shares of Translation Group stock.
The acquisition of the Netherlands-based translation services company will double Translation Group's annual revenues, the company said in a press release.
Privately held Word House has offices in the Netherlands, Germany, France, Japan, Hong Kong and the U.K.
Edouard Prisse, Word House president, will remain with the company under a three-year management contract.
The Translation Group translates conventional documents and software, specializing in translations of high-tech information in the rapidly growing information technology sector.
